about: Measured on the family piano through the iPad mic. Regenerate with tools/nn (see README there).
measured: 2026-09-26, 87 recordings labeled by Kong et al. piano transcription
octaveDownWhy: C4 fundamental ~15 dB below its 2nd harmonic: C4 read as C5 in 191 of ~290 wrong notes. With the fix: 181/190 fixed, 3/69 real C5 moved.
netWhy: Onset network (tools/nn/onset_mlp.py: 4 log-spectrum frames -> 128 hidden -> 52 keys), trained on all 87 recordings with Kong labels. 4-fold CV, used above A3 with dsp below: firm notes caught 86.3% -> 94.7%, medium+firm 74.9% -> 84.3%, false notes 323 -> 132, right letter 96.3% -> 96.4%.
